profile.hybrid_head_eye_action.name: Hybrid Head + Eye (GTA 5 / Action)
profile.hybrid_head_eye_action.desc: For GTA 5 and FPS/TPS games: turn camera with head movement, aim with left wink (right click), and shoot with right wink (left click).
profile.glasses_friendly_action.name: Glasses-Friendly Action (Head + Mouth + Mic)
profile.glasses_friendly_action.desc: Zero eye strain for glasses wearers: turn camera with head, aim with lip pucker, shoot with mic puff or cheek puff, walk with mouth open.
profile.eye_gaze_action.name: Eye Gaze & Action (Eyes Only)
profile.eye_gaze_action.desc: For players who cannot move neck or hands: look to move camera, wink left/right to aim and shoot.
profile.head_face_handsfree.name: Head & Expression Control (Hands-Free)
profile.head_face_handsfree.desc: Use a standard webcam to move the cursor with head tilts and trigger keys with facial expressions.
profile.single_switch_scan.name: Single-Switch Scanning Mode
profile.single_switch_scan.desc: For severe motor limitations: cycle through all game actions and trigger with a single key, mouth open, or breath.
profile.acoustic_nonverbal.name: Acoustic & Breath Trigger (Non-Verbal)
profile.acoustic_nonverbal.desc: No speech required: trigger game buttons with a puff of breath, click sound, or vocalization.
profile.acoustic_nonverbal.target: Non-verbal players or limited limb mobility
profile.one_hand_assist.name: One-Hand & Toggle Assist
profile.one_hand_assist.desc: Eliminates holding keys down: turn walk and sprint into single-tap toggles plus one-key combos.
profile.blind_audio_guided.name: Blind & Voice-Guided Profile
profile.blind_audio_guided.desc: High contrast, full keyboard navigation, spoken feedback, and simplified toggle controls for blind or low-vision players.
